gate_rule: smallest k with median m(k) < 1/3; none => that collection fails the HMMER headline

A.reading: Collection A crosses median m < 1/3 at k = 10 prior genomes; a diverse E. coli workload can clear the HMMER m gate after that memory depth (no speedup claimed).

B.reading: Collection B crosses median m < 1/3 at k = 1; the O157:H7 outbreak/surveillance workload can clear the HMMER m gate (no speedup claimed).

C.reading: Collection C crosses median m < 1/3 at k = 5; exact-sequence memory on S. aureus can clear the HMMER m gate (no speedup claimed).
